sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*31[·.]9%[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '40347969' AND (r.abstractText LIKE '%31.9%%' OR r.abstractText LIKE '%31·9%%') LIMIT 5
rows: Obicetrapib monotherapy decreased LDL cholesterol by 31·9% (22·1 to 41·6) versus placebo
